name: x-t5-second
about: Second guided session, stills: unknown and flagged codes that one menu change can reveal (D304, D226, D228, D238, D028, D039, D1BD, D1BF/D1C0, D306, D234, D239, D1B6) and likely codes that still lack values. Movie codes are in x-t5-second-movie. Before each change, note the setting the camera shows: the last step puts every changed item back, newest first. Gates: TONE CURVE and DR 200% are grey while D RANGE PRIORITY is on; DR 200% needs ISO 250 or higher; DIGITAL TELE-CONV. needs IMAGE QUALITY without RAW; face detection and subject detection exclude each other. No step needs a mono film simulation, so ACROS (resets COLOR) and HEIF (resets CLARITY) do not come up.

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > TONE CURVE. Move only S (shadows) until it reads S +2. Leave H as it is. Press MENU/OK.
steps.note: If TONE CURVE is grey, D RANGE PRIORITY is on: change nothing, close the menu and click Skip.

0xd321.menu: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > TONE CURVE > SHADOWS

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > DYNAMIC RANGE: 200%
steps.note: If 200% is grey, raise ISO to 250 or more, or turn D RANGE PRIORITY off; if you would rather not, click Skip.

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > COLOR SPACE: Adobe RGB
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > LONG EXPOSURE NR: OFF

0xd322.menu: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > LONG EXPOSURE NR

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > LENS MODULATION OPTIMIZER: OFF
steps.note: This confirms the live code. The C1-C7 slot copy (D1A3) needs RAW CONV. mode and is a separate check.

0xd34d.menu: IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > LENS MODULATION OPTIMIZER

steps.instruction: MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > RAW RECORDING: UNCOMPRESSED
MENU > IMAGE QUALITY SETTING > IMAGE QUALITY: FINE
steps.note: FINE means JPEG only, without RAW. The next step needs it. The last step puts your setting back.

steps.instruction: MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > DIGITAL TELE-CONV.: 1.4x
steps.note: If 1.4x is grey, click Skip.

steps.instruction: MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > DIGITAL TELE-CONV.: OFF
steps.note: This undoes the step before, so the next steps are not blocked.

steps.instruction: MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > SHUTTER TYPE: MECHANICAL SHUTTER
steps.note: Session 1 set ELECTRONIC SHUTTER and D304 did not move. If the camera already shows MECHANICAL SHUTTER, choose E-FRONT CURTAIN SHUTTER.

steps.instruction: MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > SPORTS FINDER MODE: ON
steps.note: If the item is grey, click Skip.

steps.instruction: MENU > SET UP > POWER MANAGEMENT > EVF/LCD BOOST SETTING: EVF/LCD RESOLUTION PRIORITY
steps.note: The code is a guess (D297 has four values, like this item). The log shows which code moves. If the camera already shows this option, choose EVF/LCD LOW LIGHT PRIORITY.

steps.instruction: MENU > SET UP > POWER MANAGEMENT > PERFORMANCE: ECONOMY
steps.note: The SDK lists PERFORMANCE as 1 NORMAL, 2 ECONOMY, 3 BOOST. If the camera already shows ECONOMY, choose NORMAL.

steps.instruction: MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > FLICKER REDUCTION: FIRST FRAME
steps.note: The code is a guess: PERFORMANCE and FLICKER REDUCTION both have three options. The log shows which code moves.

steps.instruction: MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > FLICKERLESS S.S. SETTING: ON
steps.note: If the item is grey, click Skip.

steps.instruction: MENU > SHOOTING SETTING > IS MODE: SHOOTING ONLY
MENU > AF/MF SETTING > AF ILLUMINATOR: ON
MENU > AF/MF SETTING > AF+MF: ON
MENU > AF/MF SETTING > FOCUS CHECK: ON
MENU > AF/MF SETTING > RELEASE/FOCUS PRIORITY > AF-S PRIORITY SELECTION: RELEASE
steps.note: Change only AF-S. Leave AF-C PRIORITY SELECTION as it is.

steps.instruction: MENU > AF/MF SETTING > DEPTH-OF-FIELD SCALE: FILM FORMAT BASIS
steps.note: Tests whether D028 is this item (two options), not COMMAND DIAL SETTING.

steps.instruction: MENU > AF/MF SETTING > MF ASSIST: DIGITAL MICROPRISM
MENU > AF/MF SETTING > AF RANGE LIMITER: PRESET1
steps.note: If the item is grey with this lens, click Skip.

steps.instruction: MENU > AF/MF SETTING > FACE/EYE DETECTION SETTING: FACE ON/EYE AUTO
steps.note: If FACE/EYE DETECTION SETTING is grey, subject detection is on: click Skip.

steps.instruction: MENU > AF/MF SETTING > FACE/EYE DETECTION SETTING: FACE ON/RIGHT EYE PRIORITY
MENU > AF/MF SETTING > SUBJECT DETECTION SETTING: SUBJECT DETECTION ON, type ANIMAL
steps.note: Turning subject detection on turns face detection off; that is expected.

steps.instruction: MENU > AF/MF SETTING > SUBJECT DETECTION SETTING: SUBJECT DETECTION ON, type BIRD
MENU > SET UP > BUTTON/DIAL SETTING > LOCK > FUNCTION SELECTION: tick the first item in the list that is not ticked. Press BACK.
steps.note: Do not change LOCK SETTING. Sources disagree on which code holds which lock category; the log shows which code moves.

steps.instruction: MENU > SET UP > SCREEN SETTING > APERTURE UNIT FOR CINEMA LENS: T NUMBER
steps.note: If the item is grey with this lens, click Skip.

0xd239.name: ApertureUnit
0xd239.menu: SCREEN SETTING > APERTURE UNIT FOR CINEMA LENS

steps.instruction: MENU > SET UP > USER SETTING > AREA SETTING > DAYLIGHT SAVINGS: OFF
steps.note: The camera clock moves by one hour. The last step puts it back.

0xd1b6.name: DaylightSavings
0xd1b6.menu: USER SETTING > AREA SETTING > DAYLIGHT SAVINGS

steps.instruction: MENU > SET UP > BUTTON/DIAL SETTING > LENS ZOOM/FOCUS SETTING > CONSTANT SPEED FOCUS (Fn): 7
steps.note: The catalog and an open plugin disagree on which code this is; the log settles it. If the item is grey with this lens, click Skip.

0xd1bf.name: ConstantSpeedFocus
0xd1bf.menu: BUTTON/DIAL SETTING > LENS ZOOM/FOCUS SETTING > CONSTANT SPEED FOCUS (Fn)

steps.instruction: MENU > SET UP > BUTTON/DIAL SETTING > LENS ZOOM/FOCUS SETTING > CONSTANT SPEED ZOOM (Fn): 2
steps.note: If the item is grey with this lens, click Skip.

0xd1c0.name: ConstantSpeedZoom
0xd1c0.menu: BUTTON/DIAL SETTING > LENS ZOOM/FOCUS SETTING > CONSTANT SPEED ZOOM (Fn)

steps.instruction: Set the focus mode selector on the body to M.
steps.note: The next step needs manual focus.

steps.instruction: Turn the focus ring all the way to infinity. Touch nothing else.
steps.note: Tests whether D226 shows the focus distance. If the screen zooms in for focus check, half-press the shutter to leave it.

steps.instruction: Put these items back, one at a time, top to bottom. Pick the setting each one had before this session. Then close the menu and click Done.
